info.title: gxnext
info.description: CLI client for the GeneXus MCP server (gxnext).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: gxnext — CLI client for the GeneXus MCP server.

commands.name: list-tools
commands.description: List the MCP tools the server currently exposes.

options.name: --server
options.description: MCP server URL (default: $GXNEXT_MCP_SERVER env var or http://127.0.0.1:1989/mcp).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Filtered output: only [ERROR]/[WARNING] lines, section starts and the final ✓/✗ (default).

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON. For tool calls: one event per line. For list-tools: a single array.

options.name: --refresh-tools
options.description: Bypass the local tools cache and re-fetch the tool list from the server.

options.name: --no-autostart
options.description: Do not auto-start the MCP server if it is unreachable on a loopback URL.
